node_definition.done_when: First reproduce at base: with the local lane declaring a lane_document that reads running 30 against concurrent_requests 22 with a fresh observed_at, _review_lane_candidates still puts that lane first (the currency report at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/reckon/s22-coord/scoring-currency/report.md shows the call). Then a lane whose own document is fresh (observed_at within 45 seconds of now) and reports running at or above concurrent_requests is treated as saturated. A saturated local lane holds the review as awaiting-lane, with a reason naming the lane and its running and ceiling figures; it never hands the review to a metered lane instead, because local-lane-shaped work stays on the local lane. The document's drained shape reads as open, not saturated: at running 0 it carries headroom null, sizing_verdict do-not-size and no concurrent_requests key, only concurrent_requests_instant. A document that is stale, unreadable or absent reads as unknown and changes nothing, so a missing reading never holds a review. A new tests/test_a_review_waits_for_a_saturated_lane.py covers the saturated case (held, reason names the figures, no pointer created), the healthy case (the local lane still leads), the drained shape (open), a stale document (unchanged ordering) and an absent document (unchanged ordering). The named negative control (ignore the lane document) reddens the saturated case. The gate is that new test plus tests/test_review_reflex_selects_a_backend.py, tests/test_rereview_keeps_its_lane.py, tests/test_review_lane_follows_its_run.py, tests/test_a_review_never_runs_in_harness.py, tests/test_review_reflex_sweep.py and tests/test_a_repair_hold_names_its_cause.py, run at base and at head. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder; each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. Every pytest process uses a basetemp private to that process. The head arm adds no failure id; any added id means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed paths report no finding the base did not. Scratch goes under /tmp in a directory named for this run and is deleted before status complete, printed and listed in artifacts. An evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion/a-review-waits-for-a-saturated-lane.html records the change. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
node_definition.goal: The review reflex reads a candidate lane's own published headroom before composing a review onto it, as scoring-should-stop-a-promotion §4b requires, so a review is not sent into a lane already over its ceiling. The change is confined to _review_lane_candidates in reckon/crew/recovery.py and the hold it feeds.
